accent.comment: JR2 — the glow under a FILLED button. NOT a rung of the 0-5 ladder (DSR §2.5's strict ordering describes distance from the page; this describes a fill bleeding into its surroundings), so never substitute one for the other. Mixed off the live fill rather than a literal so a brand-themed tenant's button glows in THEIR accent, not a hard-coded blue. An engine without color-mix invalidates the whole declaration and the button renders flat — i.e. exactly as it did before JR2 — which is why no @supports guard is needed.

danger.comment: JR2 — the same glow for the destructive fill. Two tokens rather than one parameterised by a local custom property: a `--mds-*` name assigned inside a component's <style> does NOT count as a definition to token-references.test.ts, so the parameterised form fails that gate.
